test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’.

I have never seen a man / get off his horse quick as / that stranger Englishman did.

options.text: I have never seen a man
get off his horse quick as

solution:
The correct answer is Option 4,** "get off his horse quick as".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase is "get off his horse as quickly as" or "get off his horse as quick as lightning".
 
• The error is in the order of the words, as "quick" should be an adverb modifying the verb "get off", not an adjective modifying the noun "horse".
 
• The correct sentence should be: "I have never seen a man get off his horse as quickly as that stranger Englishman did."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Option 1, "I have never seen a man", is grammatically correct.
 
• Option 2, "No error", is not the correct answer as there is an error in the sentence.
 
• Option 3, "that stranger Englishman did", is also grammatically correct.
 
• Option 5 is not provided in the question.
